name: al-spec
description: ALSpec 总入口负责识别规格任务并分流到独立的 DR、Story、TestCase SKILL；各类型 SKILL 负责具体写作与审查。

interface.longDescription: ALSpec provides a top-level routing SKILL plus three independent specification types: DR, Story, and TestCase. The entrypoint identifies the requested deliverable, selects exactly one type SKILL, and loads the canonical global or exact project template.
capabilities: Embedded writing rules with mandatory template loading
defaultPrompt: Start with the top-level al-spec SKILL to classify the requested deliverable as DR, Story, or TestCase.
Load exactly one matching type SKILL and its canonical template; use an exact project template mapping only when the project ID is confirmed.
For review requests, identify the existing specification type and route to that type SKILL.
